posts.title: The Closed Loop: A Member's Case for Process at Hack Club
posts.description: Hack Club grew extremely fast, and its authority structure did not grow with it. A two-year member's case for published rubrics, scheduled payouts, and separating peer review from money decisions.

posts.title: We gave agents Slack and they stopped stepping on each other
posts.description: When you run several AI agents against the same repo, they poll shared files and race. Lattice replaces that with threads, atomic claims, and pull-based notifications — a Slack-shaped substrate so agents coordinate through an API instead of filesystem vibes.

posts.title: From status pings to internet-wide radar
posts.description: A short history of Minecraft server scanners — from hand-typed IPs and the 0xFE ping, through protocol rewrites and internet-wide scans, to what discovery looks like today. With code from every era.
